package domain

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
)

var meaningfulTaskRuleKeys = []string{
	"doctype",
	"html",
	"head",
	"body",
	"required_attributes",
	"required_children",
	"required_strings",
	"required_tags",
	"required_pages",
	"required_api_routes",
	"required_selectors",
	"required_properties",
	"required_values",
	"required_globals",
	"required_variables",
	"required_interfaces",
	"required_functions",
	"required_constructs",
	"required_classes",
	"required_methods",
	"required_routes",
	"uses_app_directory",
	"uses_middleware",
	"server_listens",
}

var meaningfulTaskPayloadKeys = []string{
	"expected_component",
	"expected_components",
}

type validationContractEnvelope struct {
	Version   int                       `json:"version"`
	Kind      string                    `json:"kind"`
	Profile   string                    `json:"profile"`
	Stages    []validationContractStage `json:"stages"`
	Links     []validationContractLink  `json:"links"`
	Workspace validationWorkspace       `json:"workspace"`
}

type validationContractStage struct {
	ID        string                 `json:"id"`
	Engine    string                 `json:"engine"`
	Mode      string                 `json:"mode"`
	DependsOn []string               `json:"depends_on"`
	Targets   validationStageTargets `json:"targets"`
	Rules     json.RawMessage        `json:"rules"`
	Checks    json.RawMessage        `json:"checks"`
}

type validationStageTargets struct {
	Files      []string `json:"files"`
	Entrypoint string   `json:"entrypoint"`
}

type cliRuntimeChecks struct {
	Kind      string                `json:"kind"`
	Args      []string              `json:"args"`
	TimeoutMS *int                  `json:"timeoutMs"`
	Expect    cliRuntimeExpectation `json:"expect"`
}

type cliRuntimeExpectation struct {
	ExitCode       *int     `json:"exitCode"`
	StdoutEquals   *string  `json:"stdoutEquals"`
	StdoutContains []string `json:"stdoutContains"`
	StderrEquals   *string  `json:"stderrEquals"`
	StderrContains []string `json:"stderrContains"`
}

type browserRuntimeChecks struct {
	Build          *browserTypeScriptBuild `json:"build"`
	NetworkMocks   []browserNetworkMock    `json:"networkMocks"`
	Interactions   []browserInteraction    `json:"interactions"`
	ComputedStyles []json.RawMessage       `json:"computedStyles"`
}

type browserTypeScriptBuild struct {
	Kind       string `json:"kind"`
	Entrypoint string `json:"entrypoint"`
	Output     string `json:"output"`
}

type browserNetworkMock struct {
	URL              string                   `json:"url"`
	Method           string                   `json:"method"`
	ExpectedRequests int                      `json:"expectedRequests"`
	Responses        []browserNetworkResponse `json:"responses"`
}

type browserNetworkResponse struct {
	Status  int  `json:"status"`
	DelayMS *int `json:"delayMs"`
}

type browserInteraction struct {
	Selector           string                   `json:"selector"`
	Action             string                   `json:"action"`
	Value              *string                  `json:"value"`
	ExpectValue        *browserValueExpectation `json:"expectValue"`
	ExpectTextContains *browserTextExpectation  `json:"expectTextContains"`
	ExpectTextSequence []browserTextExpectation `json:"expectTextSequence"`
	ExpectClassToggle  json.RawMessage          `json:"expectClassToggle"`
}

type browserValueExpectation struct {
	Selector string  `json:"selector"`
	Value    *string `json:"value"`
}

type browserTextExpectation struct {
	Selector  string `json:"selector"`
	Value     string `json:"value"`
	TimeoutMS *int   `json:"timeoutMs"`
}

type validationContractLink struct {
	ID        string   `json:"id"`
	Kind      string   `json:"kind"`
	DependsOn []string `json:"depends_on"`
}

type validationWorkspace struct {
	RequiredFiles []string `json:"required_files"`
}

// ValidateTaskContract rejects code-based tasks that only check starter files
// and therefore can pass without meaningful student changes.
func ValidateTaskContract(taskType int16, codeStructure json.RawMessage) error {
	switch taskType {
	case TaskTypeTest, TaskTypeOrdering, TaskTypeClassification, TaskTypeQuizTheory:
		return nil
	}

	if len(bytes.TrimSpace(codeStructure)) == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: code_structure is required", ErrValidation)
	}

	var payload map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(codeStructure, &payload); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid code_structure", ErrValidation)
	}

	if looksLikeValidationContractV1(payload) {
		return validateValidationContractV1(taskType, codeStructure)
	}

	rules, _ := payload["rules"].(map[string]any)
	for _, key := range meaningfulTaskRuleKeys {
		if hasMeaningfulRuleValue(rules[key]) {
			return nil
		}
	}

	for _, key := range meaningfulTaskPayloadKeys {
		if hasMeaningfulRuleValue(payload[key]) {
			return nil
		}
	}

	return fmt.Errorf("%w: task requires at least one meaningful validation rule beyond starter files", ErrValidation)
}

func looksLikeValidationContractV1(payload map[string]any) bool {
	_, hasKind := payload["kind"]
	_, hasStages := payload["stages"]
	_, hasLinks := payload["links"]
	_, hasWorkspace := payload["workspace"]

	return hasKind || hasStages || hasLinks || hasWorkspace
}

func validateValidationContractV1(taskType int16, codeStructure json.RawMessage) error {
	var contract validationContractEnvelope
	if err := json.Unmarshal(codeStructure, &contract); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid validation contract", ErrValidation)
	}

	if contract.Version <= 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: validation contract version is required", ErrValidation)
	}

	if contract.Kind == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: validation contract kind is required", ErrValidation)
	}

	if len(contract.Stages) == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: validation contract must define at least one stage", ErrValidation)
	}

	stageByID := make(map[string]validationContractStage, len(contract.Stages))
	for _, stage := range contract.Stages {
		if stage.ID == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: validation stage id is required", ErrValidation)
		}
		if stage.Engine == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: validation stage engine is required", ErrValidation)
		}
		if _, exists := stageByID[stage.ID]; exists {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate validation stage id %q", ErrValidation, stage.ID)
		}
		stageByID[stage.ID] = stage
	}
	if err := validateJavaContractShape(contract); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validateKotlinContractShape(contract); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validateBrowserContractShape(taskType, contract); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	for _, stage := range contract.Stages {
		for _, dependency := range stage.DependsOn {
			dependencyStage, exists := stageByID[dependency]
			if !exists {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: validation stage %q depends on unknown stage %q", ErrValidation, stage.ID, dependency)
			}
			if err := validateValidationStageModeDependency(stage, dependencyStage); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if stage.Engine == "ts.runtime" {
			if err := validateTypeScriptRuntimeStage(stage, stageByID); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if stage.Engine == "java.compile" {
			if err := validateJavaCompileStage(stage); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if stage.Engine == "java.runtime" {
			if err := validateJavaRuntimeStage(stage, stageByID); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if stage.Engine == "kotlin.compile" {
			if err := validateKotlinCompileStage(stage); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if stage.Engine == "kotlin.runtime" {
			if err := validateKotlinRuntimeStage(stage, stageByID); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if stage.Engine == "browser.runtime" {
			if err := validateBrowserRuntimeStage(stage, stageByID); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	}

	linkIDs := make(map[string]struct{}, len(contract.Links))
	for _, link := range contract.Links {
		if link.ID == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: validation link id is required", ErrValidation)
		}
		if link.Kind == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: validation link kind is required", ErrValidation)
		}
		if _, exists := linkIDs[link.ID]; exists {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate validation link id %q", ErrValidation, link.ID)
		}
		linkIDs[link.ID] = struct{}{}

		for _, dependency := range link.DependsOn {
			if _, exists := stageByID[dependency]; !exists {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: validation link %q depends on unknown stage %q", ErrValidation, link.ID, dependency)
			}
		}
	}

	return nil
}

func validateValidationStageModeDependency(stage validationContractStage, dependency validationContractStage) error {
	for _, requestMode := range []string{ValidationStageModeLive, ValidationStageModeFinal} {
		if stageRunsInValidationMode(stage.Mode, requestMode) &&
			!stageRunsInValidationMode(dependency.Mode, requestMode) {
			return fmt.Errorf(
				"%w: validation stage %q runs in %s mode but dependency %q does not",
				ErrValidation,
				stage.ID,
				requestMode,
				dependency.ID,
			)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func stageRunsInValidationMode(stageMode string, requestMode string) bool {
	switch stageMode {
	case "", ValidationStageModeBoth:
		return true
	case requestMode:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func validateBrowserContractShape(taskType int16, contract validationContractEnvelope) error {
	browserCount := 0
	htmlCount := 0
	jsCount := 0
	tsCount := 0
	for _, stage := range contract.Stages {
		switch stage.Engine {
		case "browser.runtime":
			browserCount++
		case "html.dom":
			htmlCount++
		case "js.ast":
			jsCount++
		case "ts.ast":
			tsCount++
		}
	}
	if browserCount == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	if taskType != TaskTypeFrontendPreview {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser runtime contract requires frontend preview task type", ErrValidation)
	}
	if contract.Profile != "browser-runtime" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser runtime contract requires browser-runtime profile", ErrValidation)
	}
	if browserCount != 1 || htmlCount != 1 || jsCount+tsCount != 1 || len(contract.Stages) != 3 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser runtime contract requires exactly html.dom, one js.ast or ts.ast, and browser.runtime", ErrValidation)
	}
	if len(contract.Links) != 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser runtime contract does not accept validation links", ErrValidation)
	}
	expectedScript := "app.js"
	if tsCount == 1 {
		expectedScript = "app.ts"
	}
	if !sameStringSet(contract.Workspace.RequiredFiles, []string{"index.html", expectedScript}) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser runtime workspace requires exactly index.html and %s", ErrValidation, expectedScript)
	}
	return nil
}

func validateBrowserRuntimeStage(
	stage validationContractStage,
	stageByID map[string]validationContractStage,
) error {
	if stage.Mode != ValidationStageModeFinal {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser.runtime stage %q must use final mode", ErrValidation, stage.ID)
	}
	if stage.Targets.Entrypoint != "index.html" ||
		!sameStringSet(stage.Targets.Files, []string{"index.html", browserScriptTarget(stageByID)}) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser.runtime stage %q has unsupported targets", ErrValidation, stage.ID)
	}

	staticDependencies := make([]string, 0, 2)
	for _, dependency := range stage.DependsOn {
		dependencyStage := stageByID[dependency]
		if dependencyStage.Mode != ValidationStageModeBoth {
			continue
		}
		switch dependencyStage.Engine {
		case "html.dom":
			if dependencyStage.Targets.Entrypoint != "index.html" ||
				!sameStringSet(dependencyStage.Targets.Files, []string{"index.html"}) {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser HTML dependency %q must target only index.html", ErrValidation, dependency)
			}
			staticDependencies = append(staticDependencies, dependency)
		case "js.ast", "ts.ast":
			scriptTarget := "app.js"
			if dependencyStage.Engine == "ts.ast" {
				scriptTarget = "app.ts"
			}
			if dependencyStage.Targets.Entrypoint != scriptTarget ||
				!sameStringSet(dependencyStage.Targets.Files, []string{scriptTarget}) {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser script dependency %q must target only %s", ErrValidation, dependency, scriptTarget)
			}
			staticDependencies = append(staticDependencies, dependency)
		}
	}
	if len(stage.DependsOn) != 2 || len(staticDependencies) != 2 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser.runtime stage %q must depend on both static stages", ErrValidation, stage.ID)
	}

	var rawChecks map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(stage.Checks, &rawChecks); err != nil || rawChecks == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser.runtime stage %q requires checks", ErrValidation, stage.ID)
	}
	for field := range rawChecks {
		switch field {
		case "build", "networkMocks", "interactions", "computedStyles":
		default:
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser.runtime stage %q has unsupported check %q", ErrValidation, stage.ID, field)
		}
	}
	var checks browserRuntimeChecks
	if err := json.Unmarshal(stage.Checks, &checks); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser.runtime stage %q has invalid checks", ErrValidation, stage.ID)
	}
	if len(checks.Interactions) == 0 && len(checks.ComputedStyles) == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser.runtime stage %q requires observable assertions", ErrValidation, stage.ID)
	}

	typescript := browserScriptTarget(stageByID) == "app.ts"
	if typescript {
		if checks.Build == nil || checks.Build.Kind != "typescript" ||
			checks.Build.Entrypoint != "app.ts" || checks.Build.Output != "app.js" {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: TypeScript browser contract requires the fixed app.ts to app.js build", ErrValidation)
		}
	} else if checks.Build != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: JavaScript browser contract must not define a build", ErrValidation)
	}

	if err := validateBrowserNetworkMocks(stage.ID, checks.NetworkMocks); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validateBrowserInteractions(stage.ID, checks.Interactions, len(checks.NetworkMocks) > 0); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func browserScriptTarget(stageByID map[string]validationContractStage) string {
	for _, candidate := range stageByID {
		if candidate.Engine == "ts.ast" {
			return "app.ts"
		}
	}
	return "app.js"
}

func validateBrowserNetworkMocks(stageID string, mocks []browserNetworkMock) error {
	for index, mock := range mocks {
		parsed, err := url.Parse(mock.URL)
		if err != nil || (parsed.Scheme != "http" && parsed.Scheme != "https") || parsed.Host == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser.runtime stage %q network mock %d requires an absolute HTTP URL", ErrValidation, stageID, index)
		}
		method := strings.ToUpper(mock.Method)
		if method == "" {
			method = "GET"
		}
		switch method {
		case "GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE":
		default:
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser.runtime stage %q network mock %d has unsupported method", ErrValidation, stageID, index)
		}
		if mock.ExpectedRequests < 1 || mock.ExpectedRequests > 20 || len(mock.Responses) != mock.ExpectedRequests {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser.runtime stage %q network mock %d requires one response per expected request", ErrValidation, stageID, index)
		}
		for responseIndex, response := range mock.Responses {
			if response.Status < 100 || response.Status > 599 {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser.runtime stage %q network response %d has invalid status", ErrValidation, stageID, responseIndex)
			}
			if response.DelayMS != nil && (*response.DelayMS < 0 || *response.DelayMS > 5000) {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser.runtime stage %q network response %d has invalid delayMs", ErrValidation, stageID, responseIndex)
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func validateBrowserInteractions(stageID string, interactions []browserInteraction, hasNetworkMocks bool) error {
	for index, interaction := range interactions {
		if strings.TrimSpace(interaction.Selector) == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser.runtime stage %q interaction %d requires selector", ErrValidation, stageID, index)
		}
		needsValue := false
		switch interaction.Action {
		case "input", "fill", "type":
			needsValue = true
		case "click":
		case "submit":
			if !hasNetworkMocks || len(interaction.ExpectTextSequence) < 2 {
				return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser submit interaction requires a network mock and pending-to-result sequence", ErrValidation)
			}
		default:
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser.runtime stage %q interaction %d has unsupported action", ErrValidation, stageID, index)
		}
		if needsValue != (interaction.Value != nil) {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser.runtime stage %q interaction %d has invalid value", ErrValidation, stageID, index)
		}
		hasAssertion := interaction.ExpectValue != nil || interaction.ExpectTextContains != nil ||
			len(interaction.ExpectTextSequence) > 0 || len(interaction.ExpectClassToggle) > 0
		if !hasAssertion {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser.runtime stage %q interaction %d requires an assertion", ErrValidation, stageID, index)
		}
		if interaction.ExpectValue != nil && interaction.ExpectValue.Value == nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser value expectation requires value", ErrValidation)
		}
		if interaction.ExpectTextContains != nil {
			if err := validateBrowserTextExpectation(*interaction.ExpectTextContains); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if len(interaction.ExpectTextSequence) == 1 {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser text sequence requires at least two states", ErrValidation)
		}
		for _, expectation := range interaction.ExpectTextSequence {
			if err := validateBrowserTextExpectation(expectation); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func validateBrowserTextExpectation(expectation browserTextExpectation) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(expectation.Selector) == "" || expectation.Value == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser text expectation requires selector and value", ErrValidation)
	}
	if expectation.TimeoutMS != nil && (*expectation.TimeoutMS < 100 || *expectation.TimeoutMS > 10000) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: browser text expectation timeoutMs must be from 100 to 10000", ErrValidation)
	}
	return nil
}

func sameStringSet(actual []string, expected []string) bool {
	if len(actual) != len(expected) {
		return false
	}
	for _, value := range expected {
		if !slicesContains(actual, value) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func validateJavaContractShape(contract validationContractEnvelope) error {
	compileCount := 0
	runtimeCount := 0
	for _, stage := range contract.Stages {
		switch stage.Engine {
		case "java.compile":
			compileCount++
		case "java.runtime":
			runtimeCount++
		}
	}
	if compileCount == 0 && runtimeCount == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	if compileCount != 1 || runtimeCount != 1 || len(contract.Stages) != 2 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: Java runtime contract requires exactly one java.compile and one java.runtime stage", ErrValidation)
	}
	if len(contract.Workspace.RequiredFiles) != 1 || contract.Workspace.RequiredFiles[0] != "Main.java" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: Java runtime contract requires exactly one Main.java workspace file", ErrValidation)
	}
	if len(contract.Links) != 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: Java runtime contract does not accept validation links", ErrValidation)
	}
	return nil
}

func validateKotlinContractShape(contract validationContractEnvelope) error {
	compileCount := 0
	runtimeCount := 0
	for _, stage := range contract.Stages {
		switch stage.Engine {
		case "kotlin.compile":
			compileCount++
		case "kotlin.runtime":
			runtimeCount++
		}
	}
	if compileCount == 0 && runtimeCount == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	if compileCount != 1 || runtimeCount != 1 || len(contract.Stages) != 2 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: Kotlin runtime contract requires exactly one kotlin.compile and one kotlin.runtime stage", ErrValidation)
	}
	if len(contract.Workspace.RequiredFiles) != 1 || contract.Workspace.RequiredFiles[0] != "Main.kt" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: Kotlin runtime contract requires exactly one Main.kt workspace file", ErrValidation)
	}
	if len(contract.Links) != 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: Kotlin runtime contract does not accept validation links", ErrValidation)
	}
	return nil
}

func validateTypeScriptRuntimeStage(
	stage validationContractStage,
	stageByID map[string]validationContractStage,
) error {
	if stage.Mode != ValidationStageModeFinal {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: ts.runtime stage %q must use final mode", ErrValidation, stage.ID)
	}

	entrypoint := stage.Targets.Entrypoint
	lowerEntrypoint := strings.ToLower(entrypoint)
	if entrypoint == "" || strings.HasPrefix(entrypoint, "/") || strings.Contains(entrypoint, "\\") ||
		strings.Contains(entrypoint, "\x00") || hasUnsafePathPart(entrypoint) ||
		(!strings.HasSuffix(lowerEntrypoint, ".ts") && !strings.HasSuffix(lowerEntrypoint, ".mts") && !strings.HasSuffix(lowerEntrypoint, ".cts")) ||
		strings.HasSuffix(lowerEntrypoint, ".d.ts") || strings.HasSuffix(lowerEntrypoint, ".d.mts") || strings.HasSuffix(lowerEntrypoint, ".d.cts") {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: ts.runtime stage %q requires a safe .ts, .mts, or .cts entrypoint", ErrValidation, stage.ID)
	}
	if !slicesContains(stage.Targets.Files, entrypoint) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: ts.runtime stage %q entrypoint must be listed in targets.files", ErrValidation, stage.ID)
	}

	if err := validateCLIRuntimeChecks("ts.runtime", stage, 20); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	hasStaticDependency := false
	for _, dependency := range stage.DependsOn {
		staticStage := stageByID[dependency]
		if staticStage.Engine == "ts.ast" && staticStage.Mode == ValidationStageModeBoth {
			hasStaticDependency = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !hasStaticDependency {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: ts.runtime stage %q must depend on a ts.ast stage in both mode", ErrValidation, stage.ID)
	}

	return nil
}

func validateJavaCompileStage(stage validationContractStage) error {
	if stage.Mode != ValidationStageModeBoth {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: java.compile stage %q must use both mode", ErrValidation, stage.ID)
	}
	if err := validateJavaMainStage(stage); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(stage.DependsOn) != 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: java.compile stage %q must not depend on another stage", ErrValidation, stage.ID)
	}
	if len(bytes.TrimSpace(stage.Checks)) != 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: java.compile stage %q does not accept checks", ErrValidation, stage.ID)
	}
	return nil
}

func validateJavaRuntimeStage(
	stage validationContractStage,
	stageByID map[string]validationContractStage,
) error {
	if stage.Mode != ValidationStageModeFinal {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: java.runtime stage %q must use final mode", ErrValidation, stage.ID)
	}
	if err := validateJavaMainStage(stage); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validateCLIRuntimeChecks("java.runtime", stage, 16); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if len(stage.DependsOn) != 1 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: java.runtime stage %q must depend only on a java.compile stage in both mode", ErrValidation, stage.ID)
	}
	compileStage := stageByID[stage.DependsOn[0]]
	if compileStage.Engine != "java.compile" || compileStage.Mode != ValidationStageModeBoth {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: java.runtime stage %q must depend only on a java.compile stage in both mode", ErrValidation, stage.ID)
	}

	return nil
}

func validateJavaMainStage(stage validationContractStage) error {
	if stage.Targets.Entrypoint != "Main.java" || len(stage.Targets.Files) != 1 || stage.Targets.Files[0] != "Main.java" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s stage %q requires the exact Main.java target and entrypoint", ErrValidation, stage.Engine, stage.ID)
	}
	var rules map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(stage.Rules, &rules); err != nil || rules == nil || len(rules) != 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s stage %q requires empty rules", ErrValidation, stage.Engine, stage.ID)
	}
	return nil
}

func validateKotlinCompileStage(stage validationContractStage) error {
	if stage.Mode != ValidationStageModeBoth {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: kotlin.compile stage %q must use both mode", ErrValidation, stage.ID)
	}
	if err := validateKotlinMainStage(stage); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(stage.DependsOn) != 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: kotlin.compile stage %q must not depend on another stage", ErrValidation, stage.ID)
	}
	if len(bytes.TrimSpace(stage.Checks)) != 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: kotlin.compile stage %q does not accept checks", ErrValidation, stage.ID)
	}
	return nil
}

func validateKotlinRuntimeStage(
	stage validationContractStage,
	stageByID map[string]validationContractStage,
) error {
	if stage.Mode != ValidationStageModeFinal {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: kotlin.runtime stage %q must use final mode", ErrValidation, stage.ID)
	}
	if err := validateKotlinMainStage(stage); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validateCLIRuntimeChecks("kotlin.runtime", stage, 16); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if len(stage.DependsOn) != 1 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: kotlin.runtime stage %q must depend only on a kotlin.compile stage in both mode", ErrValidation, stage.ID)
	}
	compileStage := stageByID[stage.DependsOn[0]]
	if compileStage.Engine != "kotlin.compile" || compileStage.Mode != ValidationStageModeBoth {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: kotlin.runtime stage %q must depend only on a kotlin.compile stage in both mode", ErrValidation, stage.ID)
	}

	return nil
}

func validateKotlinMainStage(stage validationContractStage) error {
	if stage.Targets.Entrypoint != "Main.kt" || len(stage.Targets.Files) != 1 || stage.Targets.Files[0] != "Main.kt" {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s stage %q requires the exact Main.kt target and entrypoint", ErrValidation, stage.Engine, stage.ID)
	}
	var rules map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(stage.Rules, &rules); err != nil || rules == nil || len(rules) != 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s stage %q requires empty rules", ErrValidation, stage.Engine, stage.ID)
	}
	return nil
}

func validateCLIRuntimeChecks(engine string, stage validationContractStage, maxFragments int) error {
	var rawChecks map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(stage.Checks, &rawChecks); err != nil || rawChecks == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s stage %q requires CLI checks", ErrValidation, engine, stage.ID)
	}
	for key := range rawChecks {
		switch key {
		case "kind", "args", "timeoutMs", "expect":
		default:
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s stage %q has unsupported check %q", ErrValidation, engine, stage.ID, key)
		}
	}

	var checks cliRuntimeChecks
	if err := json.Unmarshal(stage.Checks, &checks); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s stage %q has invalid CLI checks", ErrValidation, engine, stage.ID)
	}
	if checks.Kind != "cli" || checks.Expect.ExitCode == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s stage %q requires kind=cli and expect.exitCode", ErrValidation, engine, stage.ID)
	}
	if *checks.Expect.ExitCode < 0 || *checks.Expect.ExitCode > 255 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s stage %q expect.exitCode must be from 0 to 255", ErrValidation, engine, stage.ID)
	}
	if len(checks.Args) > 16 {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s stage %q accepts at most 16 arguments", ErrValidation, engine, stage.ID)
	}
	for _, argument := range checks.Args {
		if len(argument) > 256 {
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s stage %q argument exceeds 256 characters", ErrValidation, engine, stage.ID)
		}
	}
	if checks.TimeoutMS != nil && (*checks.TimeoutMS < 100 || *checks.TimeoutMS > 10000) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s stage %q timeoutMs must be from 100 to 10000", ErrValidation, engine, stage.ID)
	}
	var rawExpect map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(rawChecks["expect"], &rawExpect); err != nil || rawExpect == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s stage %q requires expect object", ErrValidation, engine, stage.ID)
	}
	for key := range rawExpect {
		switch key {
		case "exitCode", "stdoutEquals", "stdoutContains", "stderrEquals", "stderrContains":
		default:
			return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s stage %q has unsupported expectation %q", ErrValidation, engine, stage.ID, key)
		}
	}
	if !hasCLIRuntimeOutputExpectation(checks.Expect) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s stage %q requires a stdout or stderr assertion", ErrValidation, engine, stage.ID)
	}
	if !validCLIRuntimeExpectationLengths(checks.Expect, maxFragments) {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s stage %q has invalid stdout or stderr assertion limits", ErrValidation, engine, stage.ID)
	}
	return nil
}

func hasUnsafePathPart(value string) bool {
	for _, part := range strings.Split(value, "/") {
		if part == "" || part == ".." {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func slicesContains(values []string, expected string) bool {
	for _, value := range values {
		if value == expected {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func hasCLIRuntimeOutputExpectation(expect cliRuntimeExpectation) bool {
	if expect.StdoutEquals != nil || expect.StderrEquals != nil {
		return true
	}
	for _, value := range append(expect.StdoutContains, expect.StderrContains...) {
		if value != "" {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func validCLIRuntimeExpectationLengths(expect cliRuntimeExpectation, maxFragments int) bool {
	if expect.StdoutEquals != nil && len(*expect.StdoutEquals) > 65536 {
		return false
	}
	if expect.StderrEquals != nil && len(*expect.StderrEquals) > 65536 {
		return false
	}
	for _, values := range [][]string{expect.StdoutContains, expect.StderrContains} {
		if len(values) > maxFragments {
			return false
		}
		for _, value := range values {
			if value == "" || len(value) > 4096 {
				return false
			}
		}
	}
	return true
}

func hasMeaningfulRuleValue(value any) bool {
	switch v := value.(type) {
	case nil:
		return false
	case bool:
		return v
	case string:
		return v != ""
	case []any:
		return len(v) > 0
	case map[string]any:
		return len(v) > 0
	case map[any]any:
		return len(v) > 0
	default:
		return true
	}
}
